authorization_scope: single DATA-only prospective exploratory execution; execution authorization is not human scientific review
design_rationale: The predecessor found essentially no tracking penalty at the preregistered 20-tick proprioceptive delay while feedback absence and timing shuffle were strongly worse. V4 therefore characterizes the delay-response curve with fresh seeds and fixed delays. It is a prospective exploratory sensitivity map, not a post-hoc rescue or redefinition of H-EMB-002-A.

analysis_plan.primary_characterization: paired tracking-RMSE difference of each nonzero delay versus delay_0
secondary_characterization: adjacent mean-RMSE changes across the frozen delay grid
descriptive monotonicity of the mean delay-response curve
analysis_plan.direction_convention: positive control-minus-delay_0 difference means lower tracking error at delay_0
report: fraction of paired seeds with lower delay_0 error

integrity_requirements: same initial neural state within each seed
same initial body state within each seed
same graph fingerprint within each seed
every delay arm records the exact preregistered delay
every delayed trace observes the same-run sensor tape at exactly t-delay with initial-value clamping
stopping_rule: Execute exactly 20 paired seeds across all seven arms. Retain failures; no replacement seeds and no outcome-dependent stopping.
claim_boundary: Prospective exploratory synthetic DATA characterizing proprioceptive timing sensitivity in the fixed six-neuron joint fixture after a prior 20-tick non-support result. This is not a redefinition or rescue of H-EMB-002-A, not confirmatory EVID, not independent replication, and does not establish biological proprioception, learned body schema, real-device transfer, autonomy, consciousness, or 5D superiority. Human Review remains required.
